# The front door's observable connection lifecycle, captured at the parent of
# the lifecycle refactor — after the panic containment and the charge split, so
# the charges below are the corrected ones.
#
# NOT REGENERATED BY THE TEST RUN. Editing this file is a deliberate statement
# that the front door's behaviour changed; review it as one.
#
# docs/front-door/lifecycle-baseline.md explains what is here and why.

## accept-refusal-source-cap
# one host holding its whole allowance is refused BEFORE a goroutine, a reader or a TLS buffer exists
wire:
  (no bytes — the server closed without writing)
events:
  fd.budget_refuse reason=frontdoor/source-connection-cap
close-reason: (none)
charge-delta: 0
resources-after: conns=0 pre-auth=0 control-lane-bytes=0 per-source=[] tracked=0
engine-calls:
  (none)

## tls-failure
# a peer speaking raw TLS cannot read a PostgreSQL error, so the refusal is a close and no frame
wire:
  ssl-answer "S"
events:
  fd.conn_open
  fd.tls_fail reason=tls-handshake detail=tls: first record does not look like a TLS handshake
  fd.conn_close reason=tls-handshake
close-reason: tls-handshake
charge-delta: 1
resources-after: conns=0 pre-auth=0 control-lane-bytes=0 per-source=[] tracked=0
engine-calls:
  (none)

## startup-failure-unsupported-major
# a startup refused on policy never reaches the credential exchange
wire:
  ErrorResponse S="FATAL" V="FATAL" C="28000" M="authentication failed" D="frontdoor/denied"
events:
  fd.conn_open
  fd.tls_ok
  fd.auth_denied reason=frontdoor/protocol-major-unsupported
  fd.conn_close reason=frontdoor/protocol-major-unsupported
close-reason: frontdoor/protocol-major-unsupported
charge-delta: 1
resources-after: conns=0 pre-auth=0 control-lane-bytes=0 per-source=[] tracked=0
engine-calls:
  (none)

## cancel-stale
# a cancel that resolves to nothing is answered by closing, never by a frame
wire:
  (no bytes — the server closed without writing)
events:
  fd.conn_open
  fd.cancel_received
  fd.cancel_stale
  fd.conn_close reason=cancel-request
close-reason: cancel-request
charge-delta: 0
resources-after: conns=0 pre-auth=0 control-lane-bytes=0 per-source=[] tracked=0
engine-calls:
  Cancels.CancelByKey -> false

## cancel-applied
# an applied cancel is answered exactly as a stale one is — the peer presented no credential
wire:
  (no bytes — the server closed without writing)
events:
  fd.conn_open
  fd.cancel_received
  fd.cancel_applied
  fd.conn_close reason=cancel-request
close-reason: cancel-request
charge-delta: 0
resources-after: conns=0 pre-auth=0 control-lane-bytes=0 per-source=[] tracked=0
engine-calls:
  Cancels.CancelByKey -> true

## auth-read-failure
# a peer that leaves mid-exchange is charged; our own failures are not
wire:
  (no bytes — the server closed without writing)
events:
  fd.conn_open
  fd.tls_ok
  fd.conn_close reason=auth-read-failed
close-reason: auth-read-failed
charge-delta: 1
resources-after: conns=0 pre-auth=0 control-lane-bytes=0 per-source=[] tracked=0
engine-calls:
  (none)

## auth-denied
# the uniform denial: one shape for every credential outcome, charged to the source
wire:
  ErrorResponse S="FATAL" V="FATAL" C="28000" M="authentication failed" D="frontdoor/denied"
events:
  fd.conn_open
  fd.tls_ok
  fd.auth_denied reason=frontdoor/bad-credential
  fd.conn_close reason=frontdoor/bad-credential
close-reason: frontdoor/bad-credential
charge-delta: 1
resources-after: conns=0 pre-auth=0 control-lane-bytes=0 per-source=[] tracked=0
engine-calls:
  Authn.OpenWireSessionWith user="root" db="lm-prod" app="psql" bounded=true

## handshake-write-and-normal-close
# the success sequence, then the client's Terminate
wire:
  Authentication(0)
  ParameterStatus application_name="psql"
  ParameterStatus is_superuser="off"
  ParameterStatus session_authorization="Root"
  BackendKeyData (pid and secret vary per connection)
  ReadyForQuery "I"
events:
  fd.conn_open
  fd.tls_ok
  fd.auth_ok detail=user=Root pat=laptop admitted-by=global
  fd.session_open detail=sess-abc123
  fd.session_close reason=peer-closed detail=sess-abc123
  fd.conn_close reason=peer-closed
close-reason: peer-closed
charge-delta: 0
resources-after: conns=0 pre-auth=0 control-lane-bytes=0 per-source=[] tracked=0
engine-calls:
  Authn.OpenWireSessionWith user="root" db="lm-prod" app="psql" bounded=true
  Cancels.RegisterCancelKey id="sess-abc123"
  Cancels.RevokeCancelKey id="sess-abc123"
  Authn.CloseWireSession id="sess-abc123" reason="peer-closed"

## shutdown-with-a-live-session
# Close ends a session the client has not ended — and the trail still says the peer did
wire:
  Authentication(0)
  ParameterStatus application_name="psql"
  ParameterStatus is_superuser="off"
  ParameterStatus session_authorization="Root"
  BackendKeyData (pid and secret vary per connection)
  ReadyForQuery "I"
events:
  fd.conn_open
  fd.tls_ok
  fd.auth_ok detail=user=Root pat=laptop admitted-by=global
  fd.session_open detail=sess-abc123
  fd.session_close reason=peer-closed detail=sess-abc123
  fd.conn_close reason=peer-closed
close-reason: peer-closed
charge-delta: 0
resources-after: conns=0 pre-auth=0 control-lane-bytes=0 per-source=[] tracked=0
engine-calls:
  Authn.OpenWireSessionWith user="root" db="lm-prod" app="psql" bounded=true
  Cancels.RegisterCancelKey id="sess-abc123"
  Cancels.RevokeCancelKey id="sess-abc123"
  Authn.CloseWireSession id="sess-abc123" reason="peer-closed"
